faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II position is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Plant Pathology, or any relevant discipline of life sciences to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Young Professional-II post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government guidelines for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional-II recruitment at ICAR IARI will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 42,000 per month for the Young Professional-II position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional-II at ICAR IARI is a contractual role. The appointment will be on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. How should I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted via email. Candidates should prepare their bio-data and attach all necessary documents before sending the email to the official address.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Indian Agricultural Research Institute located?
faq.answer: The Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110012.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Young Professional-II in this recruitment drive by the Indian Agricultural Research Institute.
